small.description: Single-function katas (Campaign A: caesar, fizzbuzz, rle, roman, rpn, word-tally)

medium.description: Multi-behavior tasks (Campaign B: stats, intervals, timeparse, money, matrix, csvlite)

large.description: Complex multi-file features — unmeasured; build-pipeline design value (planning, review) expected to earn out here
large.note: Corpus does not cover this tier; no data. This is where the pipeline overhead is expected to pay off.

trivial.rationale: Maps to 'small' size tier. Pipeline overhead ~2.9× at this size with no quality benefit; fast path saves ~65% turns.

complex.rationale: Pipeline overhead earns out on cross-cutting, security-sensitive, or multi-wave work.

standard.rationale: Everything between trivial and complex. Pipeline runs normally.
